key_panels.name: ParameterBar
key_panels.description: Horizontal scrollable chip-selector for live parameters: Temperatura (°C), T. Minima (°C), T. Massima (°C), Umidità (%), Vento (km/h), Raffiche (km/h), Rain Rate (mm/h), Pioggia Oggi (mm), Pressione (hPa).
key_panels.ui_token: flex gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/80

key_panels.name: NetworkFilter
key_panels.description: Toggle pills with badge counts: MeteoHub/DPCN (94), AM - Aeronautica Militare (8), Ecowitt (1), CEDOC Idrografico (118). Includes visual health status dot per network.
key_panels.ui_token: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-full transition-colors

key_panels.name: StationMatrixList
key_panels.description: Searchable list with instant filter, sorting by value (asc/desc), elevation, observation age, network badge, and click-to-flyto coordinates on map.

key_panels.name: StationMarkerBadge
key_panels.description: Leaflet DivIcon rendering small rounded numeric badge: background colored according to meteorological color ramp, high-contrast text, with distinct visual border/dimming if observation is STALE (>60 min for synoptic, historic snapshot for CEDOC) or UNAVAILABLE.
key_panels.staleness_rules: Fresh: crisp vivid bg + white text + subtle glow. Stale: striped/dashed border + 50% opacity muted bg + warning dot. CEDOC historic: amber outline tag [CEDOC-STALE].

key_panels.name: StationPopup
key_panels.description: Rich dark card showing: Station Name, Municipality/Province, Network Tag, Elevation (m s.l.m.), Live Measurement with unit, Observation Timestamp in Europe/Rome, Freshness Indicator (🟢 Live / 🟡 Aggiornato 2h fa / 🔴 Obsoleto), 24h mini sparkline / min-max values.
key_panels.ui_token: leaflet-popup-custom-dark p-3 bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 font-sans

key_panels.name: RadarAndModelPlayer
key_panels.description: Timeline scrubber with Play/Pause, 1x/2x/3x speed, step forward/back, timestamp display (Europe/Rome), layer opacity slider (0-100%), and color scale legend.

key_panels.name: DataSourceStatusModal
key_panels.description: Operational diagnostics view showing API response latency, last fetched synoptic timestamp, CEDOC snapshot notice, station count online vs degraded vs offline.

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild the frontend as an ultra-modern, high-performance operational meteorological workstation with Italian interface labels (e.g. 'Stazioni Live', 'Radar DPC', 'Modello AROME', 'Allerta Meteo', 'Rete CEDOC', 'Aeronautica Militare').
Full-screen Leaflet map MUST initialize centered over Sardinia (coords ~ [40.05, 9.08], zoom 8 or 9) with minimum zoom 7 and max bounds preventing panning away to the world map.

Implement rich mock & real-like station datasets covering all requested networks: 94 MeteoHub/DPCN stations across all Sardinian provinces (Cagliari, Sassari, Nuoro, Oristano, Sud Sardegna), 8 Aeronautica Militare official synoptic stations (Decimomannu, Cagliari Elmas, Alghero Fertilia, Olbia Costa Smeralda, Capo Bellavista, Capo Caccia, Capo Carbonara, Guardiavecchia), 1 Ecowitt station, and 118 CEDOC historic rain gauge snapshot stations.

Station marker badges MUST display numeric live values (e.g., '24.2°', '12mm', '45km/h') with background colored via meteorologist-grade ramps. CRITICAL: Provide clear visual contrast for STALE (>60 min) or historic CEDOC data (dashed borders, muted saturation, explicit 'DATO STORICO/NON IN LINEA' tag in popup).

Provide interactive Weather Layers: 1) DPC Radar VMI/SRI with full timeline slider, play/pause (1x, 2x, 3x) and radar color scale legend; 2) AROME HD model overlays with parameter switcher and run timestamp; 3) Fire FRP hotspot detections; 4) MeteoAlarm Sardinia alert bar (with simulated yellow/orange thunderstorm/wind alerts for sub-zones like Campidano, Iglesiente, Gallura).
Include Data Source Status dialog accessible from the top bar (showing freshness of DPCN, AM, Ecowitt, and marking CEDOC as 'Archivio Storico / Portale Regionale Sconnesso').

Provide 4 high-quality Tile Basemaps: Dark Operational (CartoDB Dark Matter / Stadia Dark), Satellite Hybrid (Esri World Imagery + labels), Topo/Relief (OpenTopoMap / Esri NatGeo), and Light Clean (CartoDB Positron).
Ensure mobile excellence: clean collapsible bottom sheet for the station list, touch-friendly timeline slider, no overlapping UI elements, and fast search filtering.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are faithfully applied to all interactive controls, buttons, inputs, sliders, and panels.
